blocks.h2: Water Heater Problems in Ravenswood Homes
blocks.intro: In two-flats and older homes, water heater setups vary.

items.body: Many two-flats have a heater for each unit, side by side in the basement.
Gas heaters may share a chimney with boilers or furnaces. We check the draft.
Low ceilings and narrow stairs take planning.
A leak can reach the unit below.

bodies: We repair gas and electric tank heaters, power-vent units and tankless heaters in Ravenswood homes and two-flats.
When you call, read us the label. If it's time for a new one, see [water heater installation](/chicago-ravenswood/water-heater-installation).
A yearly flush clears sediment and helps the heater last. We test the relief valve, check the anode rod and inspect the burner and venting.
Tankless heaters need descaling on a schedule.

steps.body: When the heater is near the end.

blocks.h2: Two Heaters, Two Units: What to Know
blocks.body: Many Ravenswood two-flats have a separate water heater for each unit, often installed at different times. When one fails, it's worth checking the other. If they share a chimney, both vents need to draft properly. If one heater is much newer, there's no reason to replace both. We'll look at the age and condition of each and tell you honestly what makes sense for the building.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Questions From Ravenswood Homeowners

items.q: My two-flat has two heaters. Should I replace both?
items.preview: Only if both are at the end.
items.answer: Only if both are near the end. If they're the same age, replacing them together can save a second visit.

items.q: Is it worth repairing an older heater?
items.preview: Under 8 years, usually. Over 12, usually not.
items.answer: Under about 8 years, usually yes. Past 12 or with a tank leak, replace it.

items.q: Why does my pilot keep going out?
items.preview: Often a thermocouple or a draft problem.
items.answer: Often a worn thermocouple. In older buildings, poor draft in a shared chimney can also do it.

items.q: How long do water heaters last?
Why does the upstairs unit run out of hot water first?
items.answer: Hot water cools on a long run, and the heater may be sized too small for that unit's use.

items.q: How much does water heater repair cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on the part. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what failed and the type of heater. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
